Metadata.title: Vay Đúng — Choose the right loan, or decide not to borrow
Metadata.description: See the real cost of a loan from licensed lenders, and know when not to borrow.

ok.title: This loan is within the level we recommend
ok.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. This doesn't mean a lender will approve you.

depends.title: This may be too much, depending on the rate you get
depends.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. At the lowest rate this could fit, but at higher rates it goes over. Ask for the exact monthly payment before you sign.
depends.noOffers: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. We couldn't find a suitable product to cost this loan.

too_much.title: We don't recommend borrowing this amount
too_much.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving only {headroom} for a new loan. The principal alone would be about {principalOnly} a month, before interest.

too_much_with_interest.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving only {headroom} for a new loan. Even at the lowest rate we found, this loan needs about {lowestPayment} a month.

no_income.title: We don't recommend borrowing without a regular income
no_income.body: A loan has to be repaid every month, even before you find work. Paying late adds more interest and damages your credit history.

Verdict.guidelineNote: The {limit} level is a Vay Đúng guideline, not a State Bank of Vietnam rule.

Alternatives.title: What you could do instead
Alternatives.smaller: Borrow less: about {amount} over {term} months could fit (estimate at {lender}'s highest rate).
Alternatives.longer: Repay over a longer time: the monthly payment falls, but the total cost rises.
Alternatives.payDebt: Pay down your current debts before borrowing more.
Alternatives.save: Save part of it first, then borrow less or not at all.
Alternatives.family: Ask family, or ask your employer about a salary advance.
Alternatives.avoid: Don't turn to loan sharks or loan apps of unknown origin. Never transfer any fee before you've received the loan.

Guidance.title: The type of credit that fits your need
Guidance.phone: Buying electronics: ask about installments at the store first. A true 0% plan can be cheaper than a cash loan, but ask about conversion fees and bundled insurance, and compare the total you'd pay.
Guidance.motorbike: Buying a motorbike: compare dealer installments with a cash loan. Installments usually use the bike as collateral, and the total you'd pay is the number to compare.
Guidance.education: Tuition: first ask about scholarships, paying the school in stages, and the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies' student credit programme. These can be cheaper than a consumer loan.
Guidance.medical: An emergency: check your health insurance and ask family first. If you still need to borrow, use only a licensed lender, even in a hurry.
Guidance.debt: Borrowing to pay debt: be careful, debts can snowball. First ask your current lender about extending or restructuring. Only take a new loan if its real cost is clearly lower than the old one.
Guidance.living: Borrowing for everyday spending: the loan raises your monthly payments while your income stays the same. See whether you can cut spending or get a salary advance first.
Guidance.other: A cash loan is flexible but often expensive. Borrow only what you need, and compare the total you'd pay across the options below.
Guidance.urgent: In a hurry: this is when scams are most likely. A legal lender won't ask you to transfer money before paying out your loan.

Results.title: Your results
Results.offersTitle: Your options, ordered by real cost
Results.offersTitleTooMuch: Costs for reference, if you're still considering it
Results.noOffers: No product has enough data and fits your answers. Try a different amount or repayment time.
Results.insufficientIntro: These products are from licensed lenders, but the lenders haven't published enough for us to calculate your real cost.
Results.staleReason: The data is over 90 days old and needs re-checking.
Results.why1: We order by the real rate (including known fees) at the HIGHEST level the lender publishes, because nobody knows yet which rate you'd get. The lowest rate may not be the one you get.
Results.why2: A product whose fees are all unknown can't be first, because its real cost may be higher than we can calculate.
Results.why3: No lender pays to be ranked higher. Vay Đúng takes no commission and doesn't sell your information.
Results.why4: We only list lenders on the State Bank of Vietnam's list (as of {date}).
Results.disclaimer: This is information and calculation for your reference, not financial advice, and it doesn't guarantee approval. Figures come from lenders' public pages on the date shown and may have changed. The official rate and fees are those in your contract. Read it carefully before signing.
